iconicAnchor.label: Charles James's Clover Leaf gown
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Charles James and couture traditions of material, engineering, and exact finish
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The Met describes the gown through costly silk, complex structure, disciplined geometry, line, texture, refinement, and sculptural restraint rather than visible branding or status symbols.

sources.title: Charles James: Clover Leaf
supports: Exceptional luxury can be communicated through engineering, material quality, line, texture, and prolonged refinement.
The gown's complex internal structure supports showing close craft evidence beneath an apparently controlled silhouette.

sources.title: What is Luxury?
supports: The V&A frames luxury production as an investment in time and the application of skill, using terms including precision, passion, and exclusivity.
The exhibition treats luxury as context-dependent and examines material, value, time, and making beyond consumption alone.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set.
